title: Core signer-first service-to-deployment flow

actors.name: authenticated_signer
actors.role: browser-side requester that signs public service/deployment commands

actors.name: bahia_service
actors.role: canonical control-plane publisher for public results and replaceable read models

actors.name: public_browser_relays
actors.role: browser-discovered relay set used for public read models and signer-first service/deployment requests

description: This slice covers the core public service-to-deployment path in the current web app: relay-read-model bootstrap for services, environments, artifacts, builds, deployment intents, and deployment runs; signer-first public request/result commands for service creation, policy evaluation, deployment intent creation, and deployment approval; and deployment history/detail rendering from public read models.
in_scope: services list bootstrap from public read models
deployment history/detail consumption of public read models on `/deployments` and `/deployments/[id]`
the public request/result transport kinds 5964, 5989, 5961, and 5966 together with their correlated 796x results
out_of_scope: encrypted deployment run log retrieval on `/deployments/runs/[id]`
service secrets, notifications, orgs, payments, or other encrypted request domains
legacy REST compatibility endpoints except as stale evidence to classify
direct-runtime operator actions, adoption/import, and LLM deployment flows
preconditions: The browser has an authenticated signer session
`/api/v1/system/info` advertises `relay_read_models` and at least one public browser relay URL plus a Bahia service pubkey
The Bahia relay sidecar or equivalent public relay set is reachable
The requester pubkey is authorized for the public command families it invokes
postconditions: Service/deployment commands complete through correlated public Nostr result events rather than REST CRUD responses
Deployment history and pending-approval pages derive rendered state from public replaceable read models rather than one-shot REST fetches
The core public slice does not require encrypted request kind 5980; encrypted run-log retrieval remains a separate slice

happy_paths.title: Create a service from the services list
steps: Browser bootstraps public read models from the advertised relay set
User opens the create-service modal on `/services`
Frontend publishes kind 5964 `ServiceCreate` and awaits a correlated 7963 result
Service registry read models eventually include the created service

happy_paths.title: Create and approve a deployment intent
steps: User opens `/services/[id]` for a service with available artifacts and environments
Frontend optionally issues a public signer-first policy evaluation preview for the selected artifact/environment
Frontend publishes kind 5961 `DeployRequest` and awaits a correlated 7961 result
Deployment intent read models surface the pending intent on history and pending-approval pages
Updated intent/run read models surface the approved deployment state and run projection

failure_paths.title: Public request publish rejection
failure_paths.behavior: If no relay accepts the signed public request, the command fails and the caller receives the relay rejection reason rather than a false success

failure_paths.title: Terminal public command error
failure_paths.behavior: If the correlated 796x result carries `status=error|failed`, the frontend surfaces the backend-provided error instead of treating the command as successful

failure_paths.title: Deployment pages race late-arriving store state
failure_paths.behavior: Deployment history and pending-approval pages must remain reactive to the shared controlplane store so a late-arriving 31967 update is rendered after navigation

edge_cases: Public request/result correlation must ignore spoofed results from non-service authors
Read-model bootstrap must prefer latest replaceable events and tombstones by `(kind, pubkey, d-tag)`
Service creation terminal success does not by itself normatively guarantee immediate list hydration; the authoritative list view remains the relay-backed service registry projection
non_functional_requirements: Public command publication must be signer-first and event-driven rather than REST CRUD
Bootstrap and live state must be derived from relay read models and remain reactive after navigation
The public slice must stay separate from encrypted request domains, especially deployment run log retrieval
dependencies: backend canonical control-plane kinds documented in `docs/control-planes.md` and `docs/nostr-commands.md`

ambiguities.note: `web/tests/e2e/deployment-workflow-critical.spec.js` still models the old REST CRUD workflow and is not authoritative evidence for the current signer-first slice.

The backend emits terminal 7963 service-create results and publishes service registry projections through the projector path; immediate user-visible list hydration depends on projection timing and is not separately specified as part of this slice.

human_decisions: Should immediate post-create service list hydration be promoted to an explicit acceptance criterion once backend projection timing is guaranteed?
Should signer-first policy preview be treated as a required user-visible part of the deployment flow, or remain advisory/non-blocking?
